title: harness: agent-leak-guard (zombie agent procs must be cleaned first)
desc: Blocks Agent dispatch or Agent.cmd when zombie wkappbot/codex/claude processes are detected. Forces cleanup before new delegation.
steps: SAFETY: Fires when 'wkjobs -Leaks' finds processes older than 30 minutes that are still running (zombie agents from prior sessions). Dispatching new agents when zombies are alive causes resource exhaustion and IPC timeouts.

SOLUTION: Kill the zombie processes first: 'wkappbot taskkill /IM wkappbot-core.exe' (shows classification), then 'wkappbot taskkill --force <pid,...>' for confirmed zombies. After cleanup, retry the Agent dispatch.

PREVENTION: Check for zombie processes before each major delegation session with 'wkjobs -Leaks'. The guard fires with a 30-minute age threshold -- processes older than that with no output are zombies. The 95% RAM watchdog provides backup protection.
author: claude
